verdict.rationale: Databricks has a REST API reference (databricks-docs-65) that documents types, paths, and payloads, with examples for CLI/SDK/Terraform calls (databricks-supp-api-reference-examples), but the same evidence explicitly notes 'No live try-it runner is documented,' and the openapi.json probe returned 404s, indicating no interactive/runnable explorer. missing for 10: an interactive 'try it now' console or sandbox for API calls, evidence of runnable/executable examples in the reference itself, and independent confirmation of an interactive API explorer.
